select distinct A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID id, A.FINPROD_ABBR text, A.FINPROD_ID object, decode(D.OPEN_TYPE, #{openPlanType03}, #{openPlanType03}, #{openPlanType01}) col from FIN_PRODUCT A INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = A.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}, FIN_CASH_INFO C, FIN_OPEN_RULE D where A.OPERATION_TYPE = #{openType,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID AND C.CASH_ID = D.CASH_ID AND D.OPEN_MODE != #{openMode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND (A.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')) OR A.FINPROD_ABBR like concat('%',concat(#{search},'%')))

select distinct row_number() over(order by FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID) NUM, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ABBR, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_STR, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_END, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_VDATE, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_MDATE, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_NDATE, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_TYPE,
FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID
from FIN_PRODUCT INNER JOIN PTL_MANAGE_OBJ ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.MANAGE_OBJ_ID = FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY ON PTL_MANAGE_OBJ.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.PORTFOLIO_ID AND PTL_PORTFOLIO_AUTHORITY.USER_ID = #{userId}, FIN_OPEN_PLAN where FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_ID = FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID
AND FIN_OPEN_PLAN.FINPROD_ID IN
#{item,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_TYPE = decode(FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_TYPE, #{openPlanType03}, #{openPlanType03}, #{scheduleType})
AND FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_STR between #{openDateStrStart,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and #{openDateStrEnd,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
order by FIN_PRODUCT.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, FIN_OPEN_PLAN.OPEN_DATE_STR ASC
